CORPORATE PROFILE
企業簡介
Since its founding in 1929, CHOW TAI FOOK, the flagship brand of Chow Tai Fook Jewellery Group, has been celebrated for its bold
designs and meticulous attention to detail. Our commitment to innovation and craftsmanship has made us synonymous with excellence,
value, and authenticity.

As the global Chinese luxury group, we blend contemporary designs with traditional techniques to create timeless pieces. Each
collection reflects our customers' stories and lives, celebrating their special moments. We aspire to inspire and captivate generations to
come, weaving the story of CHOW TAI FOOK into their own.

Our brand portfolio includes the iconic CHOW TAI FOOK flagship brand, HEARTS ON FIRE, ENZO, and MONOLOGUE, offering a wide
variety of products that also includes an expanding range of cutting-edge IP collaborations. With over 5,000 stores worldwide, we offer
a seamless client journey across all touchpoints that includes a network across China as well as a growing number of global locations.

Chow Tai Fook Jewellery Group Limited (SEHK: 1929) has been listed on the Main Board of the Hong Kong Stock Exchange since
December 2011. We are committed to delivering sustainable long-term value for our stakeholders by continually enhancing earnings
quality and driving higher value growth.




周大福珠寶集團的旗艦品牌「周大福」創立於 1929 年，一直透過別出心裁的設計和對細節的堅持，讓傳統成為經典。時至今日，品牌
已成為了卓越品質、非凡價值及誠信可靠的代名詞。


作為全球知名中國奢侈品集團，我們深信透過現代創新設計揉合傳統工藝，能創造出代代相傳的臻品。每個系列皆承載顧客的人生故
事，慶祝他們生命中每個珍貴時刻，並在追尋幸福的旅程中帶來啟發和激勵，讓「周大福」的品牌故事深深融入顧客的生活脈絡。


集團擁有豐富的品牌組合，除了旗艦品牌「周大福」，還有 HEARTS ON FIRE、ENZO 與 MONOLOGUE。我們亦積極開拓 IP 聯乘合作，
為顧客提供多元化的選擇。我們的業務網絡遍布中國，且持續延伸至全球多個市場。在全球設有逾 5,000 家門店，致力於全渠道為顧
客提供無縫體驗。


周大福珠寶集團有限公司 ( 香港聯交所股份代號 ：1929) 於 2011 年 12 月在香港聯合交易所主板上市，致力通過提高盈利質量和推動更
高價值的增長，為不同持份者創造可持續的長期價值。

ANNUAL RESULTS AT A GLANCE
年度業績概覽
KEY HIGHLIGHTS
FY2026 marked a year of success of our brand transformation, which is delivering high-quality earnings growth. Despite
heightened external uncertainties and unprecedented gold price volatility, the Group demonstrated solid resilience as
revenue resumed year-on-year growth of 5.3% to HK$94,398 million. Profit attributable to shareholders increased by
52.2% to a record HK$9,004 million.

Gross profit margin expanded to 32.3%, supported by higher gold prices and a higher contribution from design-led,
higher-margin iconic collections. Together with effective cost control, operating profit rose by 27.8% year-on-year to
HK$18,850 million, lifting operating profit margin to a five-year high level of 20.0%.

The Group’s Return on Equity ("ROE") increased to 28.4%, which represented a sustained improvement against our 5-year
historical average of 20.5%.

We continued to leverage our strength in design-led, iconic product offerings to resonate with customers and drive
sales momentum. Our signature collections launched over the last two years gained further traction, leading fixed-price
jewellery mix in Chinese Mainland (the "Mainland") to expand to 35.4% of Retail Sales Value ("RSV"), up from 30.6% in the
previous year.

During the financial year, we made steady progress on our brand transformation, further rolling out newly designed stores
in the Mainland and international markets. We also opened our first global flagship store in Hong Kong, which showcases
our heritage, craftsmanship and creativity, while reflecting our strategic aspiration to evolve into a luxury lifestyle brand.




主要重點
2026 財政年度見證著我們品牌轉型取得顯著成效，並帶來高質量的盈利增長。儘管外部不確定性升溫，以及黃
金價格出現前所未見的波動，惟集團展現堅實的韌性，營業額年內恢復增長，按年增加 5.3% 至 94,398 百萬港元，
股東應佔溢利增加 52.2% 至創紀錄的 9,004 百萬港元。


毛利率提升至 32.3%，乃受惠於黃金價格飆升，以及設計獨特、高毛利的標誌性產品系列銷售貢獻提升所帶動。
加上有效的成本控制，致經營溢利按年增加27.8%至18,850百萬港元，經營溢利率提升至20.0%的五年新高水平。


集團的股本回報率上升至 28.4%，較過往五年的歷史平均水平 20.5% 持續改善。


我們繼續憑藉以設計為主導的標誌性產品與顧客產生共鳴，並推動銷售增長。我們過去兩年推出的標誌性產品
系列進一步帶動銷售，令定價首飾於中國內地 (「 內地」) 的零售值貢獻由去年的 30.6% 增加至 35.4%。


我們於本財政年度穩步推進品牌轉型，在內地及國際市場進一步推出新設計門店。我們亦在香港開設了全球首
家旗艦店，其不僅展現我們的歷史文化、工藝和創造力，也反映了我們蛻變為奢侈時尚生活品牌的策略抱負。

Reclassification of gold loan impact                                         黃金借貸影響的重新分類


• We use gold loans (short position in gold) for economic hedging            • 我們利用黃金借貸 ( 黃金淡倉 ) 為經濟避險目的，以減輕
     purpose to mitigate the financial impact of the gold price                黃金存貨 ( 黃金好倉 ) 受黃金價格波動的財務影響。長線
     fluctuations on our gold inventories (long position). In the long-        而 言，預 期 黃 金 好、淡 倉 會 隨 著 黃 金 存 貨 出 售 而 相 互 抵
     term, the long and short positions in gold are expected to offset         銷 ；惟 短 線 而 言，未 平 倉 的 黃 金 借 貸 合 約 於 每 個 財 政 報
     each other, through the sales of gold inventories over time.              告 期 末 或 於 合 約 平 倉 後 按 市 場 價 格 重 估，而 遵 照會計準
     However, in the near term, the outstanding gold loan contracts            則，黃 金 存 貨 則 不 予 重 估。此 差 別 會 造 成 暫 時 的 會 計 收
     are revalued at market price at the end of each financial reporting       益或虧損。
     period or upon its settlement, while the gold inventories are not, in
     accordance with accounting standards. This disparity has given to
     an accounting gain or loss temporarily.


• In the past, such gain or loss resulting from revaluation of gold          • 以 往，因 重 估 黃 金 借 貸 而 產 生 的 相 關 收 益 或 虧 損均入賬
     loans were accounted for in our cost of goods sold (“COGS”),              至我們的「銷售成本」，並對我們所呈報的毛利及經營溢
     impacting our reported gross profit and operating profit. To better       利 帶 來 影 響。為 了 更 妥 善 地 反 映 不 受 對 沖 活 動 影響下的
     reflect our core underlying operational performance without the           核心營運表現，自 2025 財政年度起，我們現將黃金借貸
     impact of the hedging activities, we are reclassifying gold loan          重估收益或虧損由「銷售成本」重新分類為「其他收益及
     revaluation gain or loss from “COGS” to “other gains and losses”          虧損」。
     starting from FY2025.

     including cash flows from operations, bank borrowings, gold             需 求。黃 金 借 貸 亦 用 作 經 濟 避 險 目 的 以 減 輕 本 集團黃金
     loans and convertible bonds. Gold loans are also used for               存貨價格波動的財務影響。
     economic hedge purposes to mitigate the financial impact of price
     fluctuations in the Group’s gold inventories.


• The Group’s daily operation was mainly financed by operating cash        • 集 團 日 常 業 務 所 需 資 金 主 要 來 自 經 營 現 金 流 量，我們主
     flows, and relied on short-term borrowings to satisfy inventory         要以短期借貸滿足旺季時的存貨資金需求及未來擴展計
     financing needs during peak seasons, as well as working capital for     劃 所 需 營 運 資 金 及 預 計 之 外 的 需 求。本 集 團 於 償還貸款
     future expansion plans and unexpected needs. The Group has not          方面並無任何困難。
     experienced any difficulties in repaying its borrowings.


• The Group’s income and expenditure were mostly denominated               • 集 團 之 收 入 及 開 支 主 要 以 港 元 及 人 民 幣 計 值，而資產及
     in HKD and RMB, while its assets and liabilities were mostly            負 債 則 主 要 以 港 元、人 民 幣 及 美 元 計 值。由 於 我 們 中 國
     denominated in HKD, RMB and USD. No hedging instrument is               內 地 日 常 業 務 營 運 的 收 支 大 多 以 人 民 幣 結 算，對我們的
     deployed against the RMB fluctuation as most of the daily receipts      業 務 並 無 構 成 重 大 的 貨 幣 風 險，因 而 未 有 針 對 人民幣波
     and payments for our Chinese Mainland operations are both made          動動用任何對沖工具。
     in RMB, which do not pose a substantive currency exposure to our

• It is our treasury policy to maintain high liquidity in response to      • 我 們 的 庫 務 政 策 旨 在 保 持 較 高 的 流 動 資 金，以 應付營運
     the requirement of operating cash flows; and to uphold financial        現 金 流 量 的 需 求 ；同 時 謹 守 審 慎 的 財 務 政 策，避 免 涉 及

Effect of RMB fluctuation                                                  人民幣波動的影響
• As part of our business operation is in Chinese Mainland, the            • 由 於 我 們 有 部 分 業 務 在 中 國 內 地 經 營，人 民 幣的波動對
   fluctuation in RMB would have some impact on our performance.             我們的表現構成若干影響。


• Transactions entered by the Hong Kong entities but denominated           • 香港公司以人民幣計值的交易 ( 包括與中國內地附屬公
   in RMB, including the inter-group transactions with the Chinese           司進行的集團間交易 ) 會按交易當天的現貨匯率兌換為
   Mainland subsidiaries, are converted into HKD, the presentation           港 元，即 本 集 團 的 呈 列 貨 幣，而 任 何 未 結 算 的 交 易 則 會
   currency of the Group, initially using the spot rate at the date of       以 收 市 匯 率 於 結 算 日 重 新 換 算。現 貨 匯 率 與 收市匯率的
   transaction and any unsettled transactions are retranslated at the        換 算 差 異 於 損 益 賬 中 確 認，而 人 民 幣 貶 值 會 對我們的年
   closing exchange rate at the balance sheet date. Such translation         內溢利構成負面影響。
   differences between the spot rate and closing exchange rate are
   recognised as profit or loss, negatively affecting our profit for the
   year when RMB depreciated.


• Exchange difference also arises when i) incomes and expenses             • 此外，匯兌差異源於 i) 中國內地分部的收支按平均匯率
   of the Chinese Mainland segment are translated into HKD, the              換 算 為 港 元，即 本 集 團 呈 列 貨 幣，而 相 應 的 資 產 及 負 債
   presentation currency of the Group, at the average exchange               按收市匯率換算 ；及 ii) 中國內地分部的資產淨值於本財
   rate, while the corresponding assets and liabilities are translated       政年度的收市匯率較上個財政年度的收市匯率有所變動。
   at closing exchange rate and ii) the change in closing exchange           有關差異於權益中的換算儲備內確認入賬。
   rates at the current financial year of the net assets of the Chinese
   Mainland segment from the closing rates at the previous financial
   year. Such differences are recognised in the translation reserve in
   equity.

Independent non-executive directors                                         獨立非執行董事
• Bring strategic insights to the Board driving for long-term value.        • 為董事會帶來策略性見解以提升長期價值。
• Exercise independent judgement on the strategy, performance and           • 對本集團的策略、表現和風險作出獨立判斷。
   risks of the Group.
• Balance the interests of the Company, shareholders and stakeholders.      • 平衡本公司、股東及持份者之間的利益。
• INEDs act as chairmen or members of major Board committees and            • 獨 立 非 執 行 董 事 擔 任 主 要 董 事 委 員 會 的 主 席 或成員，並
   undertake detailed governance work under the respective terms of            根據各自的職權範圍進行實際的管治工作。
   reference.
• Being appointed for a term of not more than three years, subject          • 委任期為不超過三年，並須根據細則輪席退任。
   to retirement by rotation in accordance with the Articles.
• The Board has not appointed a lead INED, as it considers that             • 董 事 會 目 前 未 有 委 任 首 席 獨 立 非 執 行 董 事，因 其 認 為，
   the current Board composition, with sufficient INEDs to ensure              現時董事會的組成已具備足夠的獨立非執行董事確保有
   effective checks and balances, the absence of any material                  效 的 制 衡 機 制，董 事 會 審 議 過 程 中 不 存 在 任 何重大利益
   conflicts of interest in board deliberations, together with the             衝 突，且 同 時 透 過 本 公 司 的 投 資 者 關 係 職 能 與股東保持
   availability of effective communication channels with shareholders          有 效 的 溝 通 渠 道，整 體 安 排 已 屬 充 分。董 事 會 將 持 續 檢
   through the Company’s investor relations function are adequate.             視有關安排，並會在情況有所變化時重新考慮相關委任。
   The Board will keep the matter under review and will reconsider
   the appointment should circumstances change in the future.

Remuneration                                                              薪酬
Remuneration policy                                                       薪酬政策
• Remuneration of executive directors and senior management is            • 執 行 董 事 及 高 級 管 理 層 的 薪 酬 由 薪 酬 委 員 會 釐 定，該委
  determined by the Remuneration Committee, which comprises a               員 會 以 獨 立 非 執 行 董 事 佔 多 數，並 由 一 名 獨 立 非執行董
  majority of INEDs and is chaired by an INED.                              事擔任主席。
• The Remuneration Committee is responsible for ensuring                  • 薪 酬 委 員 會 負 責 確 保 薪 酬 待 遇 公 平 且 具 競 爭 力，並會參
  remuneration packages are fair and competitive, having regard to          考市場標準、本集團的業務策略及人才留任需求。
  market benchmarking, the Group’s business strategy and retention
  needs.

The Group’s risk culture serves as the foundation for effective risk                                        本 集 團 的 風 險 文 化 是 有 效 風 險 管 理 的 基 石，促 進 貫 徹 集 團

organisation. It is designed to support the achievement of the
following objectives:

• Balancing risk and return to support informed, risk-based decision-                                       • 平 衡 風 險 和 回 報，支 持 基 於 充 分 資 訊 和 以 風 險 為導向的
  making.                                                                                                     決策。

• Fostering a common understanding of risk management across all                                            • 在 所 有 業 務 職 能 部 門 之 間 建 立 對 風 險 的 共 同 理 解，從而
  business functions, enabling cost-effective and efficient enterprise                                        實現具成本效益且高效的企業風險管理。
  risk management.

• Facilitating the achievement of the Group’s strategic goals through                                       • 透 過 加 強 識 別 及 管 理 可 持 續 發 展 方 面 的 機 遇 和 威脅，協
  enhanced identification and management of sustainability-related                                            助達成本集團的策略性目標。
  opportunities and threats.

• Upholding the highest standards of integrity, business ethics, and                                        • 堅守最高標準的誠信、商業道德和法規遵循。

Main features of the risk identification framework                         風險識別框架的主要特點

 Diversified Risk Identification   • To ensure the completeness and robustness of our risk inventory, the Group employs a wide
 Channels                             range of risk identification channels. These channels enable us to systematically identify internal,
 多樣化的風險識別渠道                           external, emerging, and ESG-related risks that may impact the achievement of our business
                                      objectives and strategies. This multi-source approach is conducted on an ongoing basis, allowing
                                      us to maintain a comprehensive and forward-looking view of the risk landscape
                                      為確保風險清單的完整性和穩健性，本集團採用多樣化的風險識別渠道。這些渠道使我們能夠
                                      系統地識別可能影響我們達成業務目標與策略的內部、外部、新興及與 ESG 相關的風險。本集
                                      團持續採用此多來源方法，藉此全面且前瞻性地了解風險情勢

 Holistic Approach to Risk         • The Group adopts a comprehensive and structured approach to risk identification and
 Management                           assessment. We continuously evaluate risk factors that could impact on our strategic objectives
 全面的風險管理方法                            and value chain, enabling us to maintain a clear and up-to-date understanding of the Group’s
                                      risk landscape
                                      本集團採用全面且有系統的方法來識別及評估風險。我們持續評估可能影響本集團戰略目標
                                      和價值鏈的風險因素，藉此對本集團的風險情勢保持清晰且最新的了解


                                   • Risk events are systematically classified into five major categories, namely Business & Market
                                      Development, Branding & Product Innovation, Financial Management, Supply Chain Optimisation
                                      & Operational Efficiency, and Governance & Compliance. Each category is further broken down
                                      into specific risk items, supported by detailed risk descriptions, potential impacts, and mitigation
                                      measures
                                      風險事件系統性地分為五大類別，分別為業務及市場發展、品牌及產品創新、財務管理、供
                                      應鏈優化及營運效率，以及管治及合規。每個類別進一步細分為具體的風險項目，並附有詳
                                      細的風險描述、潛在影響和應對措施

 Risk Inventory Management         • The Group conducts regular reviews of its risk inventory to ensure that identified risks remain
 風險清單管理                               relevant and accurately reflect the current risk environment. These reviews evaluate any
                                      emerging or evolving risks, as well as material changes to existing ones
                                      本集團定期審閱其風險清單，確保已識別的風險保持相關，並準確反映當前的風險環境。這
                                      些審閱會評估任何新興或變化中的風險，以及現有風險的重大變化


                                   • In performing these reviews, the Group considers a wide range of inputs, including the results of
                                      internal risk assessments, external audits, independent professional reviews, and insights from
                                      industry reports and peer benchmarks
                                      在進行這些審閱時，本集團會參考多種資訊來源，包括內部風險評估結果、外部稽核、獨立
                                      專業審查，以及來自行業報告及同業基準比較的見解


                                   • To ensure our ERM Framework remains robust and forward-looking, the risk inventory
                                      incorporates key sustainability-related risks. These include environmental policies, climate
                                      change adaptation and resilience, as well as responsible resource management and sustainable
                                      practices across our supply chain
                                      為確保我們的企業風險管理框架保持穩健且具前瞻性，風險清單涵蓋關鍵的可持續發展相關
                                      風險。這些風險包括環境政策、氣候變遷的適應與韌性，以及整個供應鏈中的審慎資源管理
                                      及可持續實踐

Main features of the risk evaluation framework                            風險評估框架的主要特點

 Holistic and Integrated Risk     • Risk severity is evaluated through a structured, multi-dimensional and holistic approach involving
 Assessments                         risk owners, Risk Management Department, and senior management team. This ensures a
 全面和綜合的風險評估                          comprehensive understanding of the Group’s risk exposure
                                     透過由風險承擔負責人、風險管理部和高級管理團隊的結構化、多維度及全面的方法去檢視
                                     風險的嚴重性，以確保對本集團所面臨的風險有全面了解


                                  • Risk owners are responsible for conducting risk assessments for their respective operational
                                     units at least once a year
                                     風險承擔負責人負責每年至少一次對其營運單位進行風險評估


                                  • Risk Management Department provides guidance and support to risk owners and management,
                                     including the identification of key risk considerations, evaluation of mitigation measures, and the
                                     aggregation of common risks across business units to enable a consolidated Group-wide risk
                                     assessment
                                     風險管理部為風險承擔負責人及管理層提供指導和支持，包括識別關鍵風險考量、評估應對
                                     措施，以及整合各營運單位的共通風險，從而進行本集團層面內的綜合風險評估


                                  • The consolidated assessment results are presented in a risk heat map, which is reviewed and
                                     endorsed by senior management team
                                     綜合評估結果呈現於風險熱點圖，並由高級管理團隊審閱及批准

 Risk Appetite Statement          • The Group establishes a clearly defined Risk Appetite Statement that articulates the nature and
 風險偏好聲明                              level of risk the Group is willing to accept in pursuit of its strategic objectives, providing clear
                                     boundaries for decision-making at all levels
                                     本集團制定了明確的風險偏好聲明，闡明本集團在實現其策略目標時願意承擔的風險性質和
                                     程度，為各級決策提供清晰的界線

 Clear Risk Evaluation Criteria   • The Group has established a comprehensive set of risk evaluation criteria aligned with its
 清晰的風險評估標準                           defined risk appetite. These criteria enable a structured and consistent assessment of both the
                                     likelihood and potential impact of identified risks
                                     本集團已制定一套與既定風險偏好相符的全面風險評估準則，使已識別風險的可能性及潛在
                                     影響得以有系統及一致地評估


                                  • Risk impacts are evaluated across multiple dimensions, including brand image and reputation,
                                     operational impact, legal and regulatory compliance, health and safety, social responsibility and
                                     financial implications. This approach ensures that both quantitative (financial) and qualitative
                                     (non-financial) consequences are thoroughly considered
                                     風險影響會從多方面進行評估，包括品牌形象及聲譽、營運影響、法律及監管合規、健康與
                                     安全、社會責任及財務影響。這確保能全面考量定量（財務）與定性（非財務）的後果


                                  • In addition, the Group incorporates the dimension of "importance to stakeholders" into its
                                     evaluation process. This enables effective identification, prioritisation, and management of ESG-
                                     related risks. The Group actively engages both internal and external stakeholders to assess ESG
                                     factors that may have material impacts on its operations and stakeholders
                                     此外，本集團把「對持份者的重要性」納入評估過程，這有助於風險評估過程中有效識別及優
                                     先處理 ESG 相關事項。本集團積極與內部和外部持份者互動，以評估可能對其營運及持份者
                                     產生重大影響的 ESG 因素


                                  • The results of the risk assessment provide a clear risk rating for each identified risk, highlighting
                                     areas requiring heightened management attention and resources
                                     風險評估結果為每項已識別風險提供清晰的風險評級，並為管理層顯示需要關注和投放資源
                                     的範疇

3.    CRITICAL ACCOUNTING ESTIMATES                                       3.   主要會計估算
      The preparation of financial statements requires the use of              編製財務報表需作出會計估算，顧名思義，所作會計
      accounting estimates which, by definition, will seldom equal the         估算甚少與有關之實際結果相同。管理層在應用本集
      actual results. Management also needs to exercise judgement              團會計政策時亦需行使判斷力。
      in applying the Group’s accounting policies.


      Estimates are continually evaluated. They are based on                   估算持續評估，並以過往經驗及其他因素 ( 包括可對
      historical experience and other factors, including expectations          實體構成財務影響且在若干情況下相信屬合理的未來
      of future events that may have a financial impact on the                 事件之預期 ) 作基礎。
      entity and that are believed to be reasonable under the
      circumstances.


      The estimates and assumptions that carry a significant risk              有相當風險會引致對資產及負債的賬面值作重大調整
      of causing a material adjustment to the carrying amounts of              的估算及假設，根據財務報表附註載列於下文。
      assets and liabilities are listed below with references in the
      notes to the financial statements.

               Accounting Policy                                                        會計政策
               Revenue is measured at the fair value of the                             營業額按本集團一般業務過程中出售商品及

               goods and the provision of services in the ordinary
               course of the Group’s business.


               Revenue is recognised when control over a product                        營業額於產品或服務的控制權轉移或提供給
               or service is transferred or provided to the customer,                   客戶時確認，金額為本集團預期將有權收取之

               the Group is expected to be entitled, excluding those                    額。營業額不包括增值稅或其他銷售稅，且乃
               amounts collected on behalf of third parties. Revenue                    經扣減任何貿易折扣。
               excludes value added tax or other sales taxes and is
               after deduction of any trade discounts.

7.    INTEREST INCOME AND FINANCE COSTS                                   7.   利息收入及融資成本

       Accounting Policy                                                       會計政策
       Interest income                                                         利息收入
       Interest income from financial assets at FVPL is included in            來 自 按 公 允 值 計 入 損 益 的 金 融 資 產 的 利 息 收 入計入
       the net fair value gains and losses on these assets.                    該等資產的公允值收益及虧損淨額中。


       Interest income on financial assets at amortised cost                   按 攤 銷 成 本 計 量 的 金 融 資 產 的 利 息 收 入 使 用 實際利
       calculated using the effective interest method is recognised            率法計算，於損益確認為其他收入。
       in the profit or loss as part of other income.

       Interest income is presented as finance income where                    持 作 現 金 管 理 用 途 的 金 融 資 產 賺 取 利 息 收 入 時，利
       it is earned from financial assets that are held for cash               息 收 入 會 呈 列 為 融 資 收 入。任 何 其 他 利 息 收 入 則 計
       management purposes. Any other interest income is included              入其他收入。
       in other income.

       Interest income is calculated by applying the effective interest        利 息 收 入 將 實 際 利 率 應 用 至 金 融 資 產 賬 面 總 值計算
       rate to the gross carrying amount of a financial asset except           得 出，惟 其 後 出 現 信 貸 虧 損 的 金 融 資 產 除 外。就 信
       for financial assets that subsequently become credit-impaired.          貸 減 值 金 融 資 產，實 際 利 率 應 用 於 金 融 資 產 淨 賬 面
       For credit-impaired financial assets the effective interest rate        值 ( 扣除虧損撥備後 )。
       is applied to the net carrying amount of the financial assets
       (after deduction of the loss allowance).


       Borrowing costs                                                         借貸成本
       General and specific borrowing costs that are directly                  直 接 源 自 收 購、建 築 或 生 產 合 資 格 資 產 的 一 般 及 特
       attributable to the acquisition, construction or production of a        定 借 貸 成 本 於 完 成 及 籌 備 資 產 以 作 其 擬 定 用 途或銷
       qualifying asset are capitalised during the period of time that         售 所 需 期 間 內 資 本 化。合 資 格 資 產 指 需 要 大 量 時 間
       is required to complete and prepare the asset for its intended          籌備以作擬定用途或銷售的資產。
       use or sale. Qualifying assets are assets that necessarily take
       a substantial period of time to get ready for their intended
       use or sale.

       Investment income earned on the temporary investment of                 在特定借款撥作合資格資產支出前之暫時投資所
       specific borrowings pending their expenditure on qualifying             賺 取 之 投 資 收 入，須 從 合 資 格 資 本 化 之 借 款 成 本 中
       assets is deducted from the borrowing costs eligible for                扣除。
       capitalisation.

       Other borrowing costs are expensed in the period in which               其他借貸成本於其產生之期間內支銷。
       they are incurred.

13. PROPERTY, PLANT AND EQUIPMENT                                          13. 物業、廠房及設備

       Accounting Policy                                                     會計政策
       Property, plant and equipment including buildings held for            物 業、廠 房 及 設 備 包 括 用 以 生 產 或 提 供 貨 品 或 服 務
       use in the production or supply of goods or services, or              或作行政用途的樓宇 ( 在建工程物業除外 )，乃按歷
       for administrative purposes (other than properties under              史成本值減其後累計折舊及其後累計減值虧損 (如有)
       construction in progress) are stated at historical cost less          列賬。
       subsequent accumulated depreciation and subsequent
       accumulated impairment losses, if any.


       Historical cost includes expenditure that is directly                 歷史成本包括直接歸屬於項目收購的開支。

14. RIGHT-OF-USE ASSETS AND LEASE                                           14. 使用權資產及租賃負債
    LIABILITIES

       Accounting Policy                                                      會計政策
       Leases are recognised as a right-of-use asset and a                    租 賃 於 租 賃 資 產 可 供 本 集 團 使 用 當 日 會 確 認 為使用
       corresponding liability at the date at which the leased asset          權資產及相關負債。
       is available for use by the Group.

       Contracts may contain both lease and non-lease components.             合 約 可 能 包 含 租 賃 及 非 租 賃 成 份。本 集 團 按 照 租 賃
       The Group allocates the consideration in the contract to               及 非 租 賃 成 份 相 應 的 獨 立 價 格，將 合 約 代 價 分 配 至
       the lease and non-lease components based on their relative             租 賃 及 非 租 賃 成 份。然 而，對 本 集 團 為 承 租 人 的 房
       stand-alone prices. However, for leases of real estate for             地 產 租 賃 而 言，其 選 擇 將 租 賃 及 非 租 賃 成 份 視 為 單
       which the Group is a lessee, it has elected not to separate            一租賃成份，並無將兩者區分。
       lease and non-lease components and instead accounts for
       these as a single lease component.

       Assets and liabilities arising from a lease are initially measured     租 賃 產 生 的 資 產 及 負 債 初 始 按 現 值 計 量。租 賃 負 債
       on a present value basis. Lease liabilities include the net            包括下列租賃付款的淨現值 ：
       present value of the following lease payments:

       • fixed payments (including in-substance fixed payments),              • 固定付款 ( 包括實質固定付款 ) 扣減任何應收租
         less any lease incentives receivable;                                  賃優惠 ；


       • variable lease payment that are based on an index or a               • 取決於指數或比率的浮動租賃付款 ( 初始於開始
         rate, initially measured using the index or rate as at the             日期利用指數或比率計量 ) ；
         commencement date;

       • amounts expected to be payable by the Group under                    • 本集團根據餘值擔保預期應付的金額 ；
         residual value guarantees;

       • the exercise price of a purchase option if the Group is              • 在本集團合理確定行使採購選擇權的情況下採購
         reasonably certain to exercise that option; and                        選擇權的行使價 ；及


       • payments of penalties for terminating the lease, if the              • 在租期反映本集團行使該選擇權的情況下，終止
         lease term reflects the Group exercising that option.                  租賃的罰款。


       Lease payments to be made under reasonably certain                     根 據 合 理 確 定 延 續 選 擇 權 支 付 的 租 賃 付 款 亦 計入負
       extension options are also included in the measurement of the          債計量之內。
       liability.

       The lease payments are discounted using the interest rate              租 賃 付 款 採 用 租 賃 所 隱 含 的 利 率 予 以 貼 現。倘 無 法
       implicit in the lease. If that rate cannot be readily determined,      釐定該利率 ( 本集團的租賃一般屬此類情況 )，則使
       which is generally the case for leases in the Group, the               用 承 租 人 遞 增 借 貸 利 率，即 個 別 承 租 人 在 類 似 經 濟
       lessee’s incremental borrowing rate is used, being the rate            環 境 中 按 類 似 條 款、抵 押 及 條 件 借 入 獲 得 與 使 用 權
       that the individual lessee would have to pay to borrow the             資產價值類似的資產所需資金必須支付的利率。
       funds necessary to obtain an asset of similar value to the
       right-of-use asset in a similar economic environment with
       similar terms, security and conditions.

        To determine the incremental borrowing rate, the Group:              為釐定遞增借貸利率，本集團 ：


        • where possible, uses recent third-party financing received         • 在可能情況下，使用個別承租人最近獲得的第三
           by the individual lessee as a starting point, adjusted to           方融資為出發點，並作出調整以反映自獲得第三
           reflect changes in financing conditions since third party           方融資以來融資條件的變動 ；
           financing was received;


        • uses a build-up approach that starts with a risk-free              • 對於近期未獲得第三方融資下集團所持有的租
           interest rate adjusted for credit risk for leases held by the       賃，採用以無風險利率為出發點的累加法，並按
           subsidiaries of the Group, which does not have recent third         照租賃的信貸風險作出調整 ；及
           party financing; and


        • makes adjustments specific to the lease, e.g. term, country,       • 進行特定於租約的調整，例如期限、國家、貨幣
           currency and security.                                              及抵押。


        Lease payments are allocated between principal and finance           租 賃 付 款 於 本 金 及 融 資 成 本 之 間 作 出 分 配。融 資 成
        cost. The finance cost is charged to profit or loss over the         本 在 租 賃 期 間 於 損 益 扣 除，藉 以 令 各 期 間 的 負 債 餘
        lease period so as to produce a constant periodic rate of            額的期間利率一致。
        interest on the remaining balance of the liability for each
        period.


        Right-of-use assets are measured at cost comprising the              使用權資產按成本計量，包括以下各項 ：
        following:


        • the amount of the initial measurement of lease liability;          • 初始計量租賃負債的金額 ；


        • any lease payments made at or before the commencement              • 在開始日期或之前作出的任何租賃付款減任何已
           date less any lease incentives received;                            收租賃優惠 ；


        • any initial direct costs; and                                      • 任何初始直接成本 ；及


        • restoration costs.                                                 • 復原成本。


        Right-of-use assets are generally depreciated over the shorter       使 用 權 資 產 一 般 按 直 線 基 礎 以 資 產 可 使 用 年期或租
        of the asset’s useful life and the lease term on a straight-         期 ( 以較短者為準 ) 計算折舊。倘本集團合理確定行

15. INVESTMENT PROPERTIES                                                  15. 投資物業

       Accounting Policy                                                     會計政策
       Investment properties are properties held for long-term rental        投 資 物 業 指 為 長 線 租 金 回 報 持 有 且 不 由 本 集 團佔用
       yields and are not occupied by the Group.                             的物業。


       Investment properties are initially measured at cost, including       投資物業初步按成本 ( 包括相關交易成本及借貸成
       related transaction costs and where applicable borrowing              本 ( 如 適 用 )) 計 量。初 始 確 認 後，投 資 物 業 按 成 本
       costs. Subsequent to initial recognition, investment properties       減其後累計折舊及任何累計減值虧損列賬。
       are stated at cost less subsequent accumulated depreciation
       and any accumulated impairment losses.


       If there is a transfer from investment property to owner-             倘 將 投 資 物 業 轉 撥 至 自 用 物 業，以 擁 有 人 開 始 佔 用
       occupied property evidenced by the commencement of                    為 證，則 該 物 業 於 其 後 入 賬 時 按 變 更 用 途 日 期 之 賬
       owner’s occupation, the property shall be measured at its             面值計量。
       carrying amount at the date of change in use for subsequent
       accounting.


       Depreciation is recognised so as to write off the cost of             投 資 物 業 按 估 計 可 使 用 年 期，經 考 慮 其 估 計 剩 餘 價
       investment properties over their estimated useful lives and           值後，樓宇及土地部分按直線基準分別於 20 年或租
       after taking into account their estimated residual value, using       約年期確認折舊，以撇銷投資物業成本。
       the straight-line basis over 20 years for building element or
       lease term for land element.


       An investment property is derecognised upon disposal or               投 資 物 業 於 出 售 後 或 投 資 物 業 永 久 不 再 使 用 且預期
       when the investment property is permanently withdrawn                 出 售 不 會 產 生 未 來 經 濟 利 益 時 終 止 確 認。終 止 確 認
       from use and no future economic benefits are expected from            物業產生的任何收益或虧損 ( 按該資產之出售所得
       the disposal. Any gain or loss arising on derecognition of            款項淨額與賬面值之差額計算 ) 於該物業終止確認
       the property (calculated as the difference between the net            期間計入損益。
       disposal proceeds and the carrying amount of the asset) is
       included in profit or loss in the period in which the property is
       derecognised.

21. DEFERRED TAXATION                                                      21. 遞延稅項

       Accounting Policy                                                     會計政策
       Deferred income tax is provided in full, using the liability          遞 延 所 得 稅 採 用 負 債 法 就 資 產 負 債 之 稅 基 與 它們在
       method, on temporary differences arising between the tax              綜合財務報表之賬面值兩者之短暫時差作全數撥備。
       bases of assets and liabilities and their carrying amounts in         然 而 如 遞 延 稅 項 負 債 因 初 始 確 認 為 商 譽 而 產 生，則
       the consolidated financial statements. However, deferred              不予以確認。若遞延稅項來自交易 (不包括業務合併)
       tax liabilities are not recognised if they arise from the initial     中 對 資 產 或 負 債 的 初 始 確 認，而 在 交 易 時 不 影 響 會
       recognition of goodwill. Deferred income tax is also not              計 損 益 或 應 課 稅 盈 虧，且 不 產 生 相 等 的 應 課 稅 及 可
       accounted for if it arises from initial recognition of an asset       扣 減 暫 時 性 差 異，亦 不 作 記 賬。遞 延 稅 項 採 用 在 報
       or liability in a transaction other than a business combination       告期末前已頒佈或實際頒佈之稅率 ( 或法例 ) 釐定，
       that at the time of the transaction affects neither accounting        並 預 期 在 有 關 之 遞 延 稅 項 資 產 實 現 或 遞 延 稅 項負債
       nor taxable profit or loss and does not give rise to equal            結算時應用。
       taxable and deductible temporary differences. Deferred
       income tax is determined using tax rates (and laws) that have
       been enacted or substantively enacted by the end of the
       reporting period and are expected to apply when the related
       deferred income tax asset is realised or the deferred income
       tax liability is settled.


       Deferred tax assets are recognised only if it is probable             遞 延 稅 項 資 產 僅 在 未 來 應 課 稅 金 額 將 可 用 於 動用該
       that future taxable amounts will be available to utilise those        等暫時差額及虧損時予以確認。
       temporary differences and losses.


       Deferred tax liabilities and assets are not recognised for            倘 本 公 司 能 控 制 撥 回 暫 時 差 額 的 時 間 及 該 等 差異很
       temporary differences between the carrying amount and                 可 能 不 會 於 可 見 將 來 撥 回，則 不 會 就 境 外 業 務 投 資
       tax bases of investments in foreign operations where the              賬 面 值 與 稅 基 之 間 的 暫 時 差 額 確 認 遞 延 稅 項 負債及
       company is able to control the timing of the reversal of the          資產。
       temporary differences and it is probable that the differences
       will not reverse in the foreseeable future.


       Deferred tax assets and liabilities are offset where there is         當有可依法強制執行的權利將即期稅項資產與負
       a legally enforceable right to offset current tax assets and          債 抵 銷，而 遞 延 稅 項 結 餘 與 同 一 稅 務 機 構 相 關 時，
       liabilities and where the deferred tax balances relate to the         則 可 將 遞 延 稅 項 資 產 與 負 債 抵 銷。當 實 體 有 可 依 法
       same taxation authority. Current tax assets and tax liabilities       強 制 執 行 抵 銷 權 利 且 有 意 按 淨 額 基 準 結 算 或 同時變
       are offset where the entity has a legally enforceable right to        現 資 產 及 清 償 負 債 時，則 即 期 稅 項 資 產 與 稅 項 負 債
       offset and intends either to settle on a net basis, or to realise     抵銷。
       the asset and settle the liability simultaneously.


       Current and deferred tax is recognised in profit or loss,             即 期 及 遞 延 稅 項 將 於 損 益 中 確 認，惟 與 該 稅 項 有 關
       except to the extent that it relates to items recognised in           之 項 目 於 其 他 全 面 收 益 或 直 接 於 權 益 中 確 認 除 外。
       other comprehensive income or directly in equity. In this case,       就 此 而 言，稅 項 亦 分 別 於 其 他 全 面 收 益 或 直 接 在 權
       the tax is also recognised in other comprehensive income or           益中確認。
       directly in equity, respectively.

        Accounting Policy                                                     會計政策
        Inventories are stated at the lower of cost and net realisable        存 貨 以 成 本 及 可 變 現 淨 值 兩 者 中 的 較 低 者 入 賬。成
        value. Cost comprises direct materials, direct labour and             本 包 括 直 接 原 料、直 接 勞 工 及 適 當 比 例 的 浮 動 及 固
        an appropriate proportion of variable and fixed overhead              定間接開銷 ( 後者即按正常營運能力分配 )。所有製
        expenditure, the latter being allocated on the basis of               成 品，以 及 珠 寶 鑲 嵌 首 飾 的 原 材 料，其 成 本 均 以 特
        normal operating capacity. Cost is calculated using specific          定 識 別 基 準 計 算，而 其 他 存 貨 則 利 用 加 權 平 均 法 計

32. CAPITAL RISK MANAGEMENT                                                 32. 資本風險管理
      The Group manages its capital to ensure that the group entities         本集團管理資本旨在確保集團實體可持續經營，並透
      will be able to continue as a going concern while maximising            過維持債務與權益的最佳平衡而為股東提供最大回報。
      the return to shareholders through the optimisation of the debt
      and equity balance.


      The capital structure of the Group consists of bank borrowings,         本集團的資本架構包括銀行貸款、黃金借貸、可換股
      gold loans, liability component of convertible bonds, and equity        債券的負債部分，以及本公司股東應佔權益 ( 包括綜
      attributable to shareholders of the Company, comprising                 合財務報表所披露之股本、儲備及保留溢利 )。
      share capital, reserves and retained profits as disclosed in the
      consolidated financial statements.


      The management of the Group reviews the capital structure               本集團管理層定期檢討資本架構。本集團會考慮資本
      regularly. The Group considers the cost of capital and the              成本及各類資本相關的風險，亦透過派付股息、發行
      risks associated with each class of capital, and will balance           新股、籌集銀行貸款及黃金借貸平衡本集團整體資本
      its overall capital structure through the payment of dividends,         架構。
      new share issues as well as the raising of bank borrowings
      and gold loans.


33. FINANCIAL INSTRUMENTS                                                   33. 金融工具

        Accounting Policy                                                     會計政策
        (a)    Classification                                                 (a)   分類
               The Group classifies its financial assets in the following           本集團將其金融資產分類為以下各類 ：
               measurement categories:


               • those to be measured subsequently at fair value                    • 其後按公允值計入其他全面收益或損益的
                     (either through other comprehensive income (“OCI”)              金融資產 ；及
                     or through profit or loss); and


               • those to be measured at amortised cost.                            • 以攤銷成本計量的金融資產。

       The Group operates various post-employment schemes,                  本 集 團 營 運 多 個 僱 員 離 職 後 計 劃，包 括 定 額 福 利 及
       including both defined benefit and defined contribution              定額供款退休計劃。
       pension plans.


       The liability or asset recognised in the consolidated statement      於 綜 合 財 務 狀 況 表 就 定 額 福 利 退 休 金 計 劃 確 認的負
       of financial position in respect of defined benefit pension          債 或 資 產 乃 定 額 福 利 責 任 於 報 告 期 結 算 日 的 現值減
       plans is the present value of the defined benefit obligation         計 劃 資 產 的 公 允 值。定 額 福 利 責 任 每 年 由 獨 立 精 算
       at the end of the reporting period less the fair value of plan       師利用預測單位貸記法計算。
       assets. The defined benefit obligation is calculated annually by
       independent actuaries using the projected unit credit method.


       The present value of the defined benefit obligation is               定 額 福 利 責 任 的 現 值 利 用 以 支 付 福 利 的 貨 幣 計 值、
       determined by discounting the estimated future cash outflows         到 期 情 況 與 相 關 責 任 年 期 相 若 的 優 質 公 司 債 券的利
       using interest rates of high-quality corporate bonds that are        率，將 估 計 未 來 現 金 流 出 貼 現 而 釐 定。就 債 券 並 無
       denominated in the currency in which the benefits will be paid,      深入市場的國家而言，則利用政府債券的市場利率。
       and that have terms approximating the terms of the related
       obligation. In countries where there is no deep market in such
       bonds, the market rates on government bonds are used.


       Service cost and net interest cost on the net defined benefit        定 額 福 利 負 債 淨 額 的 服 務 成 本 及 利 息 成 本 淨 額於損
       liability are recognised in profit or loss and allocated by          益內確認，且按功能分配入「銷售及分銷成本」或「一
       function as part of “selling and distribution costs” or “general     般 及 行 政 開 支」之 一 部 分。即 期 服 務 成 本 按 僱 員 於
       and administrative expenses”. Current service cost is                本 期 提 供 服 務 產 生 定 額 福 利 責 任 之 現 值 增 幅 計 算。
       measured as the increase in the present value of the defined         利 息 成 本 淨 額 透 過 將 貼 現 率 應 用 於 定 額 福 利 責任結
       benefit obligation resulting from employee service in the            餘淨額及計劃資產公允值計算。
       current period. The net interest cost is calculated by applying
       the discount rate to the net balance of the defined benefit
       obligation and the fair value of plan assets.


       Remeasurement gains and losses arising from experience               經 驗 調 整 及 精 算 假 設 變 動 產 生 的 損 益 重 新 計 量於產
       adjustments and changes in actuarial assumptions are                 生 期 間 直 接 於 其 他 全 面 收 益 內 確 認。有 關 損 益 計 入

       obligation resulting from plan amendments or curtailments are        損益內確認為過往服務成本。
       recognised immediately in profit or loss as past service costs.


       For defined contribution plans, the Group pays contributions         就 定 額 供 款 計 劃 而 言，本 集 團 按 強 制、合 約 或 自 願
       to publicly or privately administered pension insurance plans        基 準 向 公 眾 或 私 人 管 理 退 休 金 保 險 計 劃 支 付 供 款。
       on a mandatory, contractual or voluntary basis. The Group has        本 集 團 於 支 付 供 款 後 再 無 額 外 付 款 責 任。供 款 於 到
       no further payment obligations once the contributions have           期 時 確 認 為 僱 員 福 利 開 支。預 付 供 款 於 具 有 現 金 退
       been paid. The contributions are recognised as employee              款或可供扣減未來付款時確認為資產。
       benefit expense when they are due. Prepaid contributions are
